g.text: FALSIFIED: 27/108 exact unique models — 8/8 singleton banks and 19/100 two-orbit banks.

g.text: Every case begins with all 1,541 models filtered only by sixteen observed N12 positives.

g.text: Known candidate predictions and a noiseless binary N13 membership oracle remain supplied.

g.text: 81 cases remain ambiguous (2–14 models); initial sets span 4–232 models. All 422 query/answer receipts retained.

g.text: Three M12=16 families repeat the same unordered source bank four times; the 108 cases are not independent.
